product_category.value: Immersive eXtended Reality (XR) simulation training systems for firefighting, fire extinguisher (workplace fire safety), and explosive ordnance disposal (EOD) training, serving emergency services, defence, and high-risk industries

evidence.quote: FLAIM designs, develops, and deploys immersive technology training systems that use simulation to replicate the conditions of real incidents

FLAIM creates immersive eXtended-Reality (XR) training systems to help first responders, defence teams, and high-risk industry workers prepare more effectively and confidently for real-world emergencies and life-threatening situations

product_category.note: Not a healthcare or nursing product. Three systems are named: FLAIM FTS (firefighters), FLAIM FEX (fire extinguisher), FLAIM EOD, plus the FLAIM Capture analytics platform.

evidence.quote: Powered by high-fidelity VR, multisensory immersion (heat, hose drag, smoke, and haptics), and real-world fire science
FLAIM FEX incorporates Virtual Reality scenarios, audio and industry replica equipment to deliver eXtended Reality (XR) fire extinguishing
prepare defence and humanitarian teams to handle high-stakes, hazardous operations in realistic mixed reality environments
Immersive mixed reality training for firefighters, first responders, and critical incident teams

platforms.note: Learners use VR headsets combined with physical replica equipment and haptics; the pages call this XR (counted as VR) and, for EOD and some firefighting pages, mixed reality (MR). The EOD page's 'Why mixed reality?' section lists 'VR headsets, haptic feedback, and real-world replica tools'. Capture is described as 'a web-based learner record and analytics platform' and 'a cloud based reporting tool' for organisations and trainers, so Web is not listed as a learner platform.

target_customer.value: Firefighters and emergency responders, defence personnel (Air Force ARFF, Navy damage control, Army; defence and humanitarian demining teams), and high-risk industry workforces (mining, oil and gas, manufacturing, energy, transport and transit, workplace safety and compliance).

target_customer.note: The quote 'Immserive XR/MR' keeps the page's own spelling. One testimonial is from a high school (Fern Creek High School) and one from a state health fire safety coordinator (QLD Health), but neither is stated as a target segment.

value_proposition.value: Simulation that replicates the conditions, pressure, and unpredictability of real emergencies so responses become instinctive, delivered safely and repeatably without the cost, logistics, and hazards of live fire or live ordnance training.

evidence.quote: building systems that replicate the conditions, pressure, and unpredictability of real emergencies so that the responses they demand become instinctive
with the skills and confidence to respond to fire emergencies without the logistics, cost, or hazards of traditional live fire training

value_proposition.note: Outcome claims also appear on two pages: '4x faster to train than the classroom' and '275% more confident to apply skills learned after training'. Environmental claims: 'no fuel, no foam, no water, no carcinogens'.

tagline.note: Repeated as a heading on home and about-us. Other candidates: homepage first headline after the menu 'Immersive technology training for high-risk environments' followed by 'When being prepared is non-negotiable'; about-us 'Our promise to deliver better training today for a better tomorrow'; home 'On-demand training anytime, anywhere, any place'.

pricing.note: No prices, plans, or quote requests on the 5 pages read. The site menu shows 'My Cart', 'Wishlist' and 'System Registration Licensing', and the footer links 'Terms of Sale', but no product prices appear. Calls to action are 'Contact FLAIM', 'Download Brochure' and a contact form.
